queries.query: large language model OR LLM AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network change")
queries.rationale: Capture direct applications of LLMs to NetOps, configuration generation, and change workflows to map the core phenomenon and prior empirical work.

queries.query: "generative AI" AND ("network configuration" OR ACL OR BGP OR routing OR "device config")
queries.rationale: Find studies where generative models synthesize concrete device-level configs or policy artifacts (operationally meaningful outputs).

queries.query: "intent to configuration" OR "intent-driven" "network" OR "natural language" "config generation"
queries.rationale: Locate work on translating operator intent or NL intents into configurations — a common NetOps use-case and evaluation target.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate validate repair" OR "synthesize-validate-repair" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "generative model")
queries.rationale: Search for architectures combining generation, verification, and repair loops (methodology important for operational reliability).
source_preferences: conferences on software engineering (ICSE) and PL (POPL) for analogous approaches

queries.query: "network verification" OR "formal verification" "network configuration" OR "header space analysis" OR Batfish OR Veriflow
queries.rationale: Collect formal/deterministic validators and verification tools (Batfish, HSA, Veriflow) that can serve as oracles/validators for generated configs.

queries.query: "intent-based networking" OR "network change planning" OR "change automation" "rollback" "safety"
queries.rationale: Identify work on planning, safe rollout, change validation and rollback mechanisms — crucial operational safety mechanisms for NetOps automation.

queries.query: AIOps OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "network operations benchmark" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR OWL
queries.rationale: Locate existing benchmarks, benchmark families, and evaluation suites that target network operations or AIOps to assess prior evaluation practice.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "construct validity" OR "ecological validity" "AI benchmark" "evaluation"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on the validity of AI benchmarks and measurement pitfalls to critique and shape NetOps evaluation protocols.

queries.query: "agentic AI" OR "autonomous agent" OR "agentic" "orchestration" "tool-augmented" "tool use" LLM
queries.rationale: Survey agentic/orchestrated LLM frameworks used to create multi-step operational agents (relevant for autonomous NetOps agents).

queries.query: "LLM" AND ("self-correction" OR "self-repair" OR "verifier" OR "tool use" OR "assertion checking")
queries.rationale: Find methods for LLM self-correction, verifier-assisted generation, and runtime assertion checks to inform mitigations against errors/hallucinations.
Locate documented failure modes, hallucination incidents, and hazard analyses specifically or analogously applicable to NetOps automation.

queries.query: "network configuration dataset" OR "configuration dataset" "public" OR "open" "network configs"
queries.rationale: Identify public datasets and corpora of real or synthetic configurations for training/evaluation and reproducibility.

queries.query: "network emulation" OR Mininet OR "NS-3" OR Emulab OR testbed AND ("validation" OR "NetOps automation" OR "deployment testing")
queries.rationale: Find emulation/testbed methods to validate generated configs and changes safely before deployment (essential evaluation infrastructure).
Survey human factors, trust, and explainability literature relevant to operator acceptance and safe human–AI collaboration in NetOps.

queries.query: "runtime monitoring" OR "runtime verification" OR "safety monitor" "network operations" OR "autonomous network"
queries.rationale: Find work on runtime monitors and safety guards that can block or mitigate unsafe NetOps actions produced by agents.

queries.query: "uncertainty estimation" OR calibration OR "confidence estimation" "LLM" AND (deployment OR automation OR "decision support")
queries.rationale: Collect methods for estimating or calibrating LLM confidence to inform reject/verify policies for NetOps actions.

queries.query: "program synthesis" OR "code generation" OR "program repair" "generate-validate-repair" AND (analogy to network config OR "configuration synthesis")
queries.rationale: Survey analogous domains (code generation/repair) where generate-validate-repair patterns have matured and may transfer to NetOps.
Find recent surveys and systematic reviews to quickly map the closest prior work and gaps in the literature.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers, preprints (arXiv/tech reports) with reproducible methods or publicly accessible artifacts (code, datasets, or detailed protocols).
Work explicitly addressing network operations, network configuration generation, change planning, verification, validation, rollback, or testing.
Papers proposing or evaluating generate-validate-repair, tool-assisted LLM workflows, agentic orchestration, or runtime monitors relevant to NetOps safety/reliability.
Benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites for AIOps/NetOps and papers that discuss benchmark design, construct validity, or ecological validity.
Formal verification and deterministic validators for network configurations (e.g., Batfish, header-space analysis, Veriflow) and their empirical evaluations.
Human factors studies addressing operator trust, human-in-the-loop controls, explainability, or acceptance in network automation contexts.
Emulation/testbed/validation infrastructure papers (Mininet, NS-3, Emulab) describing how to validate changes safely.
Publicly released datasets, code repositories, and tool documentation that can support reproducibility.
exclusion_criteria: Papers or materials that are purely marketing, product pages without method detail, or unverifiable internal vendor-only reports with no public artifacts.
Work unrelated to operations/configuration (purely theoretical ML/NLP papers without operational application or transferable methodology).
Non-English sources unless they include an English abstract and technical artifacts accessible in English.
Benchmarks or evaluations that only measure general language capability on trivia-style networking questions (i.e., knowledge-only tests) without operational validation.
Proprietary datasets or corpora not publicly available and with no equivalent public dataset described.
date_rationale: Primary coverage: 2018–2026 to capture the rapid emergence of large generative models, agentic LLM tooling, and recent AIOps research. Include 2000–2018 selectively for foundational work in network verification, formal methods, and change-safety (e.g., header-space analysis, early verification tools) that remain canonical. Prioritize the latest 3–5 years (2021–2026) for agentic frameworks, LLM-tooling, and empirical NetOps automation studies while retaining older foundational verification/verification-method papers as necessary.
